build.scope: offline correctness and synthetic benchmark; no pool shares

interpretation: GPU-only steady device utilization was 99%; GPU command time was approximately 99.1% of wall time. CPU idle percentage does not describe GPU activity.
Device activity is not SIMD occupancy or arithmetic efficiency; no shader hardware-counter diagnosis has been established.
Four-thread median gain was 2.17%; eight-thread median loss was 2.18%. Rates declined over the sequence; these medians are not proof of a stable gain.
Initial short prototypes reached approximately 1.99 MH/s but this is not the final sustained performance claim.
MacBook Air shared power/thermal budget and CPU scheduling warrant further profiling. ThermalState fair is not a temperature reading or proof of sole causality.
An earlier static-partition A/B run overlapped prototype compilation in its last sample and is excluded from the final comparison.
GPU-only CLI default and original desktop package are retained; CPU+GPU is an explicit experimental option.
GPU-only subsequently measured 1.733628 MH/s over 30 seconds. This was a recovery check, not a temperature-controlled comparison with the pool run.
